_about: Printed books in which Clifford Lord's 1943 List and Index of Presidential Executive Orders, Unnumbered Series says the text of an early (1789-1899) order is printed. Every one here is a public-domain government publication with a page-level OCR copy on the Internet Archive. Keys match the citation forms Lord uses: 'X Richardson App. 83' -> RICH_X (appendix), '1898 MR 23' -> MR_1898, '1880 GLO 53' -> GLO_1880. A book is a printed compilation, never the signed original; everything cut from it is a lead.

editions.richardson: James D. Richardson, A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents, 1789-1897, published by authority of Congress, GPO 1896-1899 (ten volumes). Lord cites this edition's pagination. The Bureau of National Literature reprints (1908-1917, 11 or 20 volumes) are repaginated and must not be used.
editions.mr: War Department, Office of the Judge-Advocate-General, Military Reservations, National Military Parks, and National Cemeteries: Title and Jurisdiction (GPO 1898), and United States Military Reservations, National Cemeteries, and Military Parks (GPO 1907, 1910, 1916). Each entry says how the reservation was created, often 'by Executive order dated ...'.
editions.glo: Annual Report of the Commissioner of the General Land Office (GPO, yearly). Lord's 'YEAR GLO page' cites the report for that year. Some Internet Archive copies are the Department of the Interior's omnibus annual report, whose pagination differs; the job checks the title page and marks the edition.
